text: My money does not work while I sleep. My money sits on a counter and re-reads the bill I did not ask it to confirm.
name: Simone Alder

text: My checking account filed a claim against me, and by the time I read it, my balance had already settled.
name: Ray Okafor

text: The bank explained the fee in layers, like a door, and I was already out the back by the time I understood which one.
name: Tim Llanas
